name: Gigit Kuku
source:
Pai’e along with his friend, Medan are two failed entrepreneurs who, due to impending bankruptcy, resorted to black magic. They met a shaman who claimed that her magic can grant any wish.

However, they must go through a ritual called ‘kuku’ or fingernail ritual. What would be their fate? 

[From [url=https://sy-i2y8n.itch.io/gigit-kuku]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Pa’e和他的朋友Medan是两位失败的企业家，由于即将破产，他们诉诸了黑魔法。他们遇到了一位萨满，她声称她的魔法可以实现任何愿望。

然而，他们必须经历一种称为“kuku”或指甲仪式的仪式。他们的命运将会怎样？

[来自[url=https://sy-i2y8n.itch.io/gigit-kuku]Itch.io[/url]]
